_comment: Personality traits (#176). docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-23-traits-design.md is the design; core/traits.gd reads this file. Every effect is {when, gives, text?}: `when` keys biome/board/night/band/site are decided at fight start (step 1) and bloodied/first_round/alone/vs_faction/vs_type/dtype_in/dtype_out at the roll (step 2); `gives` keys ac/to_hit/save/initiative/damage/ward/save_adv are live in a fight, the rest (skill, travel, forage, gold, opinion, the hardship ones...) are shown and marked not yet in play. Each live trait's `_measured` line is tests/sweep_traits.gd's (2026-09-23): none moves the win rate by more than 3 points, which is the seed noise floor — re-run it when a number here changes.

brave.name: Brave
brave.text: Walks toward the thing everyone else is backing away from.
brave._measured: MEASURED 2026-09-23 (tests/sweep_traits.gd, 300 seeds, all three presets holding it, normal): win 88.7% vs 88.7% (+0.0) — never fired: no fear save in the sweep's rosters

effects.text: Advantage on a hardship's fear save
−2 when the company tries to slip past a band

craven.name: Craven
craven.text: Alive, which is more than can be said for some of the brave ones.
craven._measured: MEASURED 2026-09-23 (tests/sweep_traits.gd, 300 seeds, all three presets holding it, normal): win 91.7% vs 88.7% (+3.0), counts in 98% of fights

effects.text: Disadvantage on a hardship's fear save
